name: sdlc
description: Adopt and follow the Spec-First Collaborative SDLC: a document-driven workflow aligned with Anthropic's AI-Native SDLC Playbook (AGENTS.md source of truth, an intent/spec/plan artifact chain, ADRs, REVIEW policy, HANDOFF, CHANGELOG, and enforced intent/decision/spec/plan/test/review/handoff gates plus a production boundary) that persists across sessions and compaction.
